description: Reederey87 GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 dual-Spark source refresh at v1.6.0 (aad6481c94b20ef4853ea07819f3f4ea2ec18f33, 2026-10-05). Keeps the byte-exact Mia-AiLab TR3 4 bpw primary Model and the source launcher’s exact incoai DFlash2 drafter pin 7d74cdd881ed7e32c31175984a67823127b66cfe (non-commercial, no derivatives). The recipe-owned ARM64 ExLlamaV3 build is 1.4.9 5be886578ec80324c2c715269387be2058724b6e (its six EXL3 quant/MoE source files are byte-identical to 1.4.7, preserving the fused-kernel/ticket-scheduler ABI). v1.6.0 adds the prefix-admission and resident-tail scheduler patches, the 50 ms shared-memory recheck and the adaptive-k batch margin and position trim; upstream's release notes name them part of its production image (e3-armc-shm50), so the image bakes the first three and the recipe enables the last two (upstream's measurements, not measured here). The digest-pinned vLLM base image is unchanged. Refreshes the current GLM/DFlash2 overlay/test closure, retains Vonk’s non-root read-only runtime wrapper and build-time patching, and carries upstream’s default-on sparse-cache-miss metric and prompt-token detail reporting. Default serving remains DFlash2 k=7, TP2 across two Sparks, fp8 KV and the existing context envelope. Upstream’s performance and DFlash2 acceptance evidence is not Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance; local build and runtime qualification remain separate gates. The drafter license terms are shown in its Model document. The target-only Model has no historical drafter dependency; cache preparation uses only this recipe's explicitly selected drafter. Default thinking effort is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: reasoning_effort high (upstream production default). GB10 fit: GPU utilization 0.67 bounds the declared 112,544,365,097-byte peak (including draft overhead), above the 112,406,862,720-byte per-rank loading need. The peak retains the platform floor; hardware acceptance remains required.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 DFlash2 vLLM two Sparks (Reederey87)
